create or alter view [dbo].[FollowDetail] as with ArtifactTypes as ( select F.ID as FollowID, F.ResourceID, 1 as HardFollow, F.AssetId, F.AssetTypeID from Follow F inner join AssetType Att on F.AssetTypeID = Att.ID and Att.Class in (1,8) where F.AssetTypeID is not null and FollowTypeID = 3 union all select P.ID as FollowID, P.ResourceID, 0 as HardFollow, A.ID AssetID, A.AssetTypeID from Follow P inner join AssetType ATT on P.AssetTypeID = ATT.ID and Att.Class in (1,8) inner join Asset A on A.AssetTypeID = Att.ID where P.FollowTypeID = 3 and P.AssetTypeID is not null ), DomainTypes as ( select F.ID as FollowID, F.ResourceID, 1 as HardFollow, F.AssetID, F.AssetTypeID from Follow F inner join AssetType Att on Att.ID = F.AssetTypeId and Att.Class = 9 where F.FollowTypeID = 3 and F.AssetTypeId is not null ), Groups as ( select P.ID as FollowID, P.ResourceID, 0 as HardFollow, A.ID AssetId, P.AssetTypeID from Follow P inner join AssetType Att on Att.ID = P.AssetTypeId and Att.Class = 12 inner join Asset A on A.AssetTypeID = Att.ID inner join [Group] C on C.ID = A.SourceID where P.FollowTypeID = 3 and P.AssetTypeId is not null ), PolicyTypes as ( select F.ID as FollowID, F.ResourceID, 1 as HardFollow, F.AssetId, F.AssetTypeId from Follow F inner join AssetType Att on Att.ID = F.AssetTypeId and Att.Class = 6 where F.FollowTypeID = 3 and F.AssetTypeId is not null union all select P.ID as FollowID, P.ResourceID, 0 as HardFollow, A.ID, A.AssetTypeID from Follow P inner join AssetType ATT on ATT.ID = P.AssetTypeID and Att.Class = 6 inner join Asset A on A.AssetTypeID = Att.ID Where P.FollowTypeID = 3 and P.AssetTypeId is not null ), PolicyParents as ( select F.ID as FollowID, cast(null as bigint) as ParentID, F.ResourceID, 1 as HardFollow, A.ID AssetID, cast(Null as bigint) ParentAssetID, A.AssetTypeID from Follow F inner join Asset A on F.AssetID = A.ID inner join AssetType Att on A.AssetTypeID = Att.Id and Att.Class = 6 left join PredicateIntersect I on I.ObjectAssetID = A.ID and I.PredicateType = 4 where I.IntersectID is null and F.FollowTypeID = 3 and F.AssetID is Not Null union all select P.FollowID, I.SubjectAssetID as ParentID, P.ResourceID, 0 as HardFollow, A.ID AssetID, I.SubjectAssetID as ParentAssetID, A.AssetTypeID from Asset A inner join AssetType Att on A.AssetTypeID = Att.Id and Att.Class = 6 inner join PredicateIntersect I on I.ObjectAssetID = A.ID and I.PredicateType = 4 inner join PolicyParents p on I.SubjectAssetID = p.AssetID ), Resources as ( select P.ID as FollowID, P.ResourceID, 0 as HardFollow, A.ID as AssetID, P.AssetTypeID from Follow P inner join AssetType Att on Att.ID = P.AssetTypeId and Att.Class = 11 inner join Asset A on A.AssetTypeId = Att.ID inner join reporting.Global_Resource C on C.ResourceID = A.SourceID where P.FollowTypeID = 3 and P.AssetTypeId Is Not Null and C.ResourceID > 0 ), TaxonomyParents as ( select F.ID as FollowID, null as ParentID, F.ResourceID, 1 as HardFollow, A.ID AssetID, cast(Null as bigint) ParentAssetID, A.AssetTypeID from Follow F inner join Asset A on F.AssetID = A.ID inner join AssetType Att on A.AssetTypeID = Att.Id and Att.Class = 2 left join PredicateIntersect I on I.ObjectAssetID = A.ID and I.PredicateType = 4 where I.IntersectID is null and F.FollowTypeID = 3 and F.AssetID is Not Null union all select P.FollowID, I.SubjectAssetID as ParentID, P.ResourceID, 0 as HardFollow, A.ID AssetID, I.SubjectAssetID as ParentAssetID, A.AssetTypeID from Asset A inner join AssetType Att on A.AssetTypeID = Att.Id and Att.Class = 2 inner join PredicateIntersect I on I.ObjectAssetID = A.ID and I.PredicateType = 4 inner join PolicyParents p on I.SubjectAssetID = p.AssetID ), TaxonomyTypes as ( select F.ID as FollowID, F.ResourceID, 1 as HardFollow, F.AssetId, F.AssetTypeID from Follow F inner join AssetType Att on F.AssetTypeID = Att.ID and Att.Class = 2 where F.FollowTypeID = 3 and F.AssetTypeID is not null union all select P.ID as FollowID, P.ResourceID, 0 as HardFollow, A.ID AssetID, A.AssetTypeID from Follow P inner join AssetType Att on P.AssetTypeID = Att.ID and Att.Class = 2 inner join Asset A on A.AssetTypeID = Att.ID where P.FollowTypeID = 3 and P.AssetTypeID is not null ), RuleTypes as ( select F.ID as FollowID, F.ResourceID, 1 as HardFollow, F.AssetId, F.AssetTypeID from Follow F inner join AssetType Att on F.AssetTypeID = Att.ID and Att.Class = 7 where F.FollowTypeID = 3 and F.AssetTypeID is not null union all select P.ID as FollowID, P.ResourceID, 0 as HardFollow, A.ID AssetID, A.AssetTypeID from Follow P inner join AssetType Att on P.AssetTypeID = Att.ID and Att.Class = 7 inner join Asset A on A.AssetTypeID = Att.ID where P.FollowTypeID = 3 and P.AssetTypeID is not null )
select F.FollowID, F.ResourceID, R.Email, R.Email as FollowerEmail, R.FirstName + ' ' + R.LastName as FollowerName, R.FirstName as FollowerFirstName, R.LastName as FollowerLastName, 'Resource' as FollowerObjectType, F.ResourceID as FollowerObjectID, dbo.GenerateAssetUrl((select A.ID from Asset A inner join AssetType att on att.id = a.assettypeid and att.class = 11 where A.SourceID = F.ResourceID)) as FollowerUrl, A.ID as AssetID, coalesce(F.AssetID,F.AssetTypeID) as ID, coalesce(AName.DisplayValue,OAT.Name) Name, coalesce(AName.DisplayValue,OAT.Name) TextPath, cast(null as nvarchar) Description, cast(null as int) ParentID, cast(null as varchar) ParentType, coalesce(AUrl.Url,ATUrl.Url) as Url, case coalesce(AAT.Class,OAT.Class) when 11 then 'User' when 12 then 'Group' else coalesce(AAT.Name,OAT.Name) end as [TypeName], coalesce(AATS.IconBackColor,OATS.IconBackColor,'#000') IconBackColor, coalesce(AATS.IconForeColor,OATS.IconForeColor, '#fff') IconForeColor, coalesce(AATS.IconText, OATS.IconText , 'leaf') IconText, 0 AS OpenEventCount, cast(S.Value as decimal(4,3)) as CurrentScore, cast(F.HardFollow as bit) as HardFollow, coalesce(AAT.ID,OAT.ID) AssetTypeID from ( select FollowID, ResourceID, HardFollow, AssetID, AssetTypeID from ArtifactTypes union select FollowID, ResourceID, HardFollow , AssetID, AssetTypeID from DomainTypes union select FollowID, ResourceID, HardFollow, AssetID, AssetTypeID from Groups union select FollowID, ResourceID, HardFollow, AssetID, AssetTypeID from PolicyTypes union select FollowID, ResourceID, HardFollow, AssetID, AssetTypeID from PolicyParents union select FollowID, ResourceID, HardFollow, AssetID, AssetTypeID from Resources union select FollowID, ResourceID, HardFollow, AssetID, AssetTypeID from TaxonomyParents union select FollowID, ResourceID, HardFollow, AssetID, AssetTypeID from TaxonomyTypes union select FollowID, ResourceID, HardFollow, AssetID, AssetTypeID from RuleTypes union select ID as FollowID, ResourceID, 1 as HardFollow, AssetID, AssetTypeID from Follow where FollowTypeID = 1 ) F inner join reporting.Global_Resource R on R.ResourceID = F.ResourceID left join Asset A on A.ID = F.AssetID and F.AssetID is not null left join AssetType AAT on AAT.ID = A.AssetTypeID left join AssetTypeStyle AATS on AATS.ID = AAT.ID outer apply [dbo].[GetAssetDisplayValueById](A.ID) AName outer apply [dbo].[GetAssetUrlById](A.ID) AUrl left Outer Join AssetType OAT on OAT.ID = F.AssetTypeID and F.AssetID is null left join AssetTypeStyle OATS on OATS.ID = OAT.ID outer apply [dbo].[GetAssetTypeUrlByID](OAT.ID) ATUrl outer apply ( select S.Value from metrics.Score S inner join metrics.Allocation Al on Al.Uid = S.AllocationUid and Al.ScoreType = 1 and Al.OverrideName is null and S.AssetUid = A.[Uid] and S.EffectiveDate <= getutcdate() and (S.EndDate >= getutcdate() or S.EndDate is null) ) S where (A.ID IS NOT NULL OR OAT.ID IS NOT NULL)
